CLIP (with atom IDs): E14.034 | 01:02.00-01:07.00 | CAM | Close-up on Tobin's hands gripping the rail.
E14.035 | 01:02.20-01:07.00 | ACT | Tobin grabs Mara by the wrist.
E14.036 | 01:02.40-01:05.06 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, cruel) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E14.037 | 01:07.00-01:13.00 | CAM | Low angle on Mara framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.038 | 01:07.40-01:09.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, nervous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
E14.039 | 01:13.00-01:16.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E14.040 | 01:13.40-01:15.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, afraid) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
E14.041 | 01:16.00-01:19.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Mara's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E14.042 | 01:16.40-01:18.80 | DLG | CORIN (protective, low) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E14.043 | 01:19.00-01:24.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.044 | 01:24.00-01:28.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Mara toward Tobin.
E14.045 | 01:24.40-01:27.44 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, mocking) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E14.046 | 01:28.00-01:33.00 | CAM | Low angle on Selene framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.047 | 01:28.40-01:31.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
